description: The seam between the two diamonds: the one problem the second diamond is opened on, and the ones it is not. discarded is required because a definition that names only what it kept cannot be audited — the reader cannot tell whether an option was considered and rejected or never seen at all.

problem_statement.description: The single problem the run commits to solving, stated so that a solution to a different problem would be visibly off-target.

in_scope.description: What the second diamond may explore.

out_of_scope.description: What it may not, and the neighbouring problems this one must not collapse into.

success_criteria.description: Observations that would confirm the problem was solved. Each checkable by someone who did not do the work.

discarded.description: Problems the brief surfaced and this definition set aside, each with its reason.

audience.description: Who the delivered answer is for, carried forward from the seed.
